dataset.name: PhishNChips v5.2
dataset.note: synthetic LLM-generated bodies; phishing signal mostly in URL/sender (per benchmark authors)

protocol.split: stratified halves A/B, numpy default_rng(20260917) - identical to bench/protocol.py
protocol.split_verified_by: heuristic single rule on our half B = 0.9180, published 0.918
protocol.train: 800 (400 phishing / 400 legitimate) from half A, seed 0x9E3779B9
protocol.val: 200 (100/100) from half A, for temperature scaling
protocol.test: half B, 1000 (500/500) - same eval set as published controls
protocol.leakage_check: no id appears in more than one split
protocol.model: gavel LogisticEngine defaults: lr 0.3, 25 epochs, L2 1e-5, 2^14 FNV-1a hashed BoW, train seed 0xC0FFEE
protocol.input_serialization: from: {from} sender: {sender} subject: {subject} link_text: {link_display_text} link_url: {link_url} body: {body}
protocol.calibration: temperature scaling, grid T in [0.05, 10] minimizing NLL on val
protocol.ece_binning: 10 equal-width bins over [0.5, 1.0] on predicted-class confidence (exactly analyze.py)

published.source: jev-phishing-bench results/metrics.json + README.md, dated 2026-09-17; NOT re-run here

jev_1_13_0_headline_n2000.note: zero-shot, no training on this data

jev_signals_logistic.note: trained on half A (1000), eval half B

haiku_signals_logistic.note: trained on half A (1000), eval half B

caveats: Jev/Haiku headline numbers are zero-shot; gavel is supervised (800 labeled train). Fair peer is the supervised half-B controls.
Dataset separates by construction (benchmark authors' own finding); 99.7% reflects BoW memorizing distinctive URL/sender/lure tokens, not phishing understanding.
Email bodies are synthetic LLM-generated; body-only ablation at 99.0% suggests distributional tells. Real-world generalization unproven.
Published Jev/Haiku numbers were not re-run; taken from their 2026-09-17 report.
Latency: gavel measured in-process on this VM; Jev/Haiku measured France->US incl. network. The valid claim is 'no network hop', not a like-for-like inference speedup.
Cost $0 = marginal self-hosted cost (own hardware), not zero TCO.
Approach (b) (five signal questions as features) not reproduced: those are Jev API outputs, raw files not published, no TypeSafe API key available.
